description_zh: Warren McCulloch 和 Walter Pitts 提出第一个数学神经元模型，为神经网络奠定理论基础。
description_en: Warren McCulloch and Walter Pitts propose the first mathematical neuron model, laying the theoretical foundation for neural networks.

description_zh: Claude Shannon 发表《Programming a Computer for Playing Chess》，开创计算机博弈论。
description_en: Claude Shannon publishes "Programming a Computer for Playing Chess", pioneering computer game theory.

description_zh: 艾伦·图灵提出"模仿游戏"，即后来的图灵测试，作为判断机器是否具有智能的标准。
description_en: Alan Turing proposes the "Imitation Game", later known as the Turing Test, as a criterion for machine intelligence.

description_zh: Arthur Samuel 开发 IBM 第一个跳棋程序，首次实现机器自学习概念。
description_en: Arthur Samuel develops IBM's first checkers program, pioneering the concept of machine self-learning.

description_zh: Allen Newell 和 Herbert Simon 创造 Logic Theorist，第一个能证明数学定理的AI程序。
description_en: Allen Newell and Herbert Simon create Logic Theorist, the first AI program capable of proving mathematical theorems.

description_zh: 达特茅斯人工智能夏季研究项目召开，标志着"人工智能"作为一门学科的诞生。
description_en: The Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence is held, marking the birth of AI as a discipline.

title_zh: 感知机：首个神经计算机
description_zh: Frank Rosenblatt 发明感知机 Mark I，首个基于神经网络原理的硬件实现。
description_en: Frank Rosenblatt invents the Perceptron Mark I, the first hardware implementation based on neural network principles.

description_zh: John McCarthy 创建 LISP，成为人工智能研究的主流编程语言长达数十年。
description_en: John McCarthy creates LISP, becoming the dominant programming language for AI research for decades.

description_zh: Newell 和 Simon 开发 GPS，首个尝试模拟人类问题求解过程的程序。
description_en: Newell and Simon develop GPS, the first program attempting to simulate human problem-solving processes.

description_zh: Arthur Samuel 正式提出"机器学习"术语，定义为"让计算机无需显式编程就能学习的能力"。
description_en: Arthur Samuel formally coins the term "Machine Learning", defining it as "the field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed."

description_zh: Edward Feigenbaum 等人开发 DENDRAL，首个基于知识的专家系统，用于推断分子结构。
description_en: Edward Feigenbaum and colleagues develop DENDRAL, the first knowledge-based expert system for inferring molecular structures.

description_zh: 斯坦福研究院开发 SHAKEY 机器人，首个能够感知环境并自主行动的移动机器人。
description_en: Stanford Research Institute develops SHAKEY, the first mobile robot capable of perceiving its environment and acting autonomously.

description_zh: Joseph Weizenbaum开发了ELIZA，这是最早的自然语言处理程序之一，能够模拟心理治疗师。
description_en: Joseph Weizenbaum develops ELIZA, one of the earliest natural language processing programs, capable of simulating a psychotherapist.

description_zh: Minsky和Papert出版《感知机》一书，指出了单层神经网络的局限性，导致了神经网络研究的第一次低潮。
description_en: Minsky and Papert publish "Perceptrons", highlighting the limitations of single-layer neural networks, leading to the first decline in neural network research.

description_zh: Alain Colmerauer 在马赛大学开发 Prolog，开创逻辑编程范式。
description_en: Alain Colmerauer develops Prolog at University of Marseille, pioneering the logic programming paradigm.

title_zh: Lighthill 报告与第一次AI寒冬
title_en: Lighthill Report and the First AI Winter
description_zh: 英国科学家 James Lighthill 发表批评报告，导致 AI 研究资金大幅削减，开启第一次 AI 寒冬。
description_en: British scientist James Lighthill publishes a critical report, leading to massive funding cuts for AI research and starting the first AI Winter.

description_zh: 斯坦福 Cart 在 Hans Moravec 领导下实现自主导航，通过立体视觉穿越障碍环境。
description_en: Stanford Cart achieves autonomous navigation under Hans Moravec, traversing obstacle courses using stereo vision.

title_zh: 日本第五代计算机项目
description_zh: 日本启动第五代计算机系统项目，投资巨额研发智能计算机，引发全球 AI 竞赛。
description_en: Japan launches the Fifth Generation Computer Systems project, investing heavily in intelligent computers and sparking a global AI race.

description_zh: 斯坦福大学开发的 MYCIN 专家系统在血液感染诊断上达到专家水平。
description_en: MYCIN expert system developed at Stanford achieves expert-level performance in diagnosing blood infections.

description_zh: John Laird、Allen Newell 和 Paul Rosenbloom 开发 Soar，通用认知架构的重要尝试。
description_en: John Laird, Allen Newell, and Paul Rosenbloom develop Soar, an important attempt at a general cognitive architecture.

description_zh: Rumelhart、Hinton 和 Williams 推广反向传播算法，神经网络研究重新兴起。
description_en: Rumelbart, Hinton, and Williams popularize the backpropagation algorithm, reviving neural network research.

title_zh: Lisp 机崩溃与第二次AI寒冬
title_en: Lisp Machine Crash and the Second AI Winter
description_zh: 专用 Lisp 机市场崩溃，AI 硬件公司纷纷倒闭，开启第二次 AI 寒冬。
description_en: Dedicated Lisp machine market collapses, AI hardware companies fail, starting the second AI Winter.

title_zh: LeCun 卷积神经网络手写识别
description_zh: Yann LeCun 在贝尔实验室开发卷积神经网络，成功应用于手写数字识别。
description_en: Yann LeCun at Bell Labs develops convolutional neural networks, successfully applying them to handwritten digit recognition.

description_zh: Chris Watkins 提出 Q-learning，成为强化学习领域最基础和广泛使用的算法之一。
description_en: Chris Watkins proposes Q-learning, becoming one of the most fundamental and widely used algorithms in reinforcement learning.

title_en: XCON: Commercial Success of Expert Systems
description_zh: XCON（R1）为DEC公司每年节省数千万美元，标志着专家系统在商业上的巨大成功。
description_en: XCON (R1) saves DEC millions of dollars annually, marking a huge commercial success for expert systems.

description_zh: Vapnik 等人完善 SVM 理论，成为机器学习领域最重要的算法之一。
description_en: Vapnik and colleagues refine SVM theory, becoming one of the most important algorithms in machine learning.

description_zh: Hochreiter 和 Schmidhuber 提出 LSTM，解决循环神经网络的长期依赖问题。
description_en: Hochreiter and Schmidhuber propose LSTM, solving the long-term dependency problem of recurrent neural networks.

description_zh: Yann LeCun 发表 LeNet-5 架构和 MNIST 数据集，成为深度学习经典基准。
description_en: Yann LeCun publishes LeNet-5 architecture and MNIST dataset, becoming classic benchmarks for deep learning.

description_zh: Larry Page 和 Sergey Brin 发明 PageRank，奠定 Google 搜索引擎的核心技术。
description_en: Larry Page and Sergey Brin invent PageRank, laying the core technology foundation for Google search engine.

description_zh: IBM的深蓝计算机在标准比赛中击败世界国际象棋冠军加里·卡斯帕罗夫。
description_en: IBM's Deep Blue computer defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov in a standard match.

description_zh: Leo Breiman 提出随机森林，成为机器学习领域最成功的集成学习方法之一。
description_en: Leo Breiman proposes Random Forest, becoming one of the most successful ensemble learning methods in machine learning.

description_zh: iRobot 推出 Roomba 家用扫地机器人，成为最成功的消费级机器人产品。
description_en: iRobot launches Roomba home vacuum robot, becoming the most successful consumer robot product.

title_zh: 深度信念网络：深度学习复兴
title_en: Deep Belief Network: Deep Learning Revival
description_zh: Geoffrey Hinton 提出深度信念网络，开创深度学习训练的有效方法。
description_en: Geoffrey Hinton proposes Deep Belief Networks, pioneering effective methods for training deep learning.

description_zh: Fei-Fei Li 团队发布 ImageNet 大规模图像数据集，成为深度学习发展的关键基础设施。
description_en: Fei-Fei Li's team releases ImageNet large-scale image dataset, becoming key infrastructure for deep learning development.

description_zh: AlexNet在ImageNet竞赛中以大幅优势夺冠，标志着深度学习时代的开始。
description_en: AlexNet wins the ImageNet competition by a large margin, marking the beginning of the deep learning era.

title_zh: Watson 战胜 Jeopardy 人类冠军
description_zh: IBM Watson 在知识问答节目 Jeopardy 中击败人类冠军，展示自然语言理解的突破。
description_en: IBM Watson defeats human champions in the quiz show Jeopardy, demonstrating breakthrough in natural language understanding.

description_zh: Google 的 Tomas Mikolov 发布 Word2Vec，开创词嵌入技术的新时代。
description_en: Google's Tomas Mikolov releases Word2Vec, pioneering a new era of word embedding technology.

description_zh: DeepMind的AlphaGo以4:1战胜围棋世界冠军李世石，展示了深度强化学习的威力。
description_en: DeepMind's AlphaGo defeats Go world champion Lee Sedol 4-1, demonstrating the power of deep reinforcement learning.

description_zh: 《Attention Is All You Need》论文发表，提出Transformer架构，彻底改变NLP领域。
description_en: The paper "Attention Is All You Need" is published, introducing the Transformer architecture and revolutionizing NLP.

description_zh: Ian Goodfellow 提出生成对抗网络，开创深度生成模型的新范式。
description_en: Ian Goodfellow proposes Generative Adversarial Networks, pioneering a new paradigm for deep generative models.

description_zh: Geoffrey Hinton 等人提出 Dropout 技术，有效防止神经网络过拟合。
description_en: Geoffrey Hinton and colleagues propose Dropout technique, effectively preventing neural network overfitting.

description_zh: 牛津大学 VGG 团队提出 VGGNet，证明小卷积核堆叠可以构建更深的网络。
description_en: Oxford VGG team proposes VGGNet, demonstrating that stacking small convolution kernels can build deeper networks.

title_zh: 注意力机制：序列对齐新方法
title_en: Attention Mechanism: New Approach to Sequence Alignment
description_zh: Dzmitry Bahdanau 等人提出注意力机制，解决序列到序列模型的长距离依赖问题。
description_en: Dzmitry Bahdanau and colleagues propose attention mechanism, solving long-range dependency problem in sequence-to-sequence models.

description_zh: 微软研究院提出 ResNet，通过残差连接解决深度网络训练难题。
description_en: Microsoft Research proposes ResNet, solving deep network training difficulties through residual connections.

description_zh: Elon Musk、Sam Altman 等人创立 OpenAI，致力于开发安全的人工通用智能。
description_en: Elon Musk, Sam Altman, and others found OpenAI, dedicated to developing safe artificial general intelligence.

description_zh: Google 开源 TensorFlow 深度学习框架，成为最流行的机器学习平台之一。
description_en: Google open sources TensorFlow deep learning framework, becoming one of the most popular machine learning platforms.

title_zh: 微软语音识别达人类水平
title_en: Microsoft Speech Recognition Reaches Human Parity
description_zh: 微软宣布其语音识别系统在 Switchboard 基准测试中达到人类水平。
description_en: Microsoft announces its speech recognition system achieves human parity on Switchboard benchmark.

title_en: AlphaGo Zero: No Human Knowledge Required
description_zh: DeepMind 发布 AlphaGo Zero，仅通过自我对弈学习，超越所有围棋AI。
description_en: DeepMind releases AlphaGo Zero, learning only through self-play and surpassing all Go AI.

description_zh: Facebook 发布 PyTorch 深度学习框架，以其动态计算图特性赢得研究者青睐。
description_en: Facebook releases PyTorch deep learning framework, winning researchers over with its dynamic computation graph.

description_zh: Google 提出 BERT，通过双向 Transformer 实现突破性的语言理解能力。
description_en: Google proposes BERT, achieving breakthrough language understanding through bidirectional Transformers.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-1，首次展示生成式预训练在语言理解任务上的潜力。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-1, first demonstrating the potential of generative pre-training on language understanding tasks.

description_zh: NVIDIA 提出 StyleGAN，生成前所未有高质量的人脸图像。
description_en: NVIDIA proposes StyleGAN, generating unprecedented high-quality face images.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-2，因担心滥用而分阶段发布，展现大模型涌现能力。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-2 in stages due to misuse concerns, demonstrating emergent capabilities of large models.

description_zh: OpenAI Five 击败 Dota2 世界冠军战队，展示 AI 在复杂团队游戏中的能力。
description_en: OpenAI Five defeats Dota2 world champion team, demonstrating AI capability in complex team games.

title_en: GPT-3: Scale is All You Need
description_zh: OpenAI 发布拥有1750亿参数的 GPT-3，展示大规模语言模型的涌现能力。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters, demonstrating emergent capabilities of large-scale language models.

description_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaFold2 在 CASP14 竞赛中达到实验精度，解决50年生物学难题。
description_en: DeepMind's AlphaFold2 achieves experimental accuracy in CASP14, solving a 50-year biology challenge.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 DALL·E，首次实现从文本描述生成高质量图像。
description_en: OpenAI releases DALL·E, first achieving high-quality image generation from text descriptions.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 CLIP，通过对比学习实现强大的视觉-语言理解能力。
description_en: OpenAI releases CLIP, achieving powerful vision-language understanding through contrastive learning.

description_zh: GitHub 与 OpenAI 发布 Copilot，开创 AI 辅助编程新时代。
description_en: GitHub and OpenAI release Copilot, pioneering a new era of AI-assisted programming.

title_en: Stable Diffusion: Open Source Image Generation
description_zh: Stability AI 发布开源的 Stable Diffusion，引爆文本到图像生成革命。
description_en: Stability AI releases open-source Stable Diffusion, sparking the text-to-image generation revolution.

description_zh: Midjourney 发布，以独特的艺术风格生成能力赢得设计师青睐。
description_en: Midjourney releases, winning designers' favor with unique artistic style generation capabilities.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 DALL·E 2，生成更高质量、更逼真的图像。
description_en: OpenAI releases DALL·E 2, generating higher quality, more realistic images.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 InstructGPT，展示人类反馈强化学习对齐语言模型的方法。
description_en: OpenAI releases InstructGPT, demonstrating alignment of language models through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback.

description_zh: OpenAI发布ChatGPT，凭借其惊人的对话能力迅速风靡全球，开启生成式AI热潮。
description_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT, which takes the world by storm with its amazing conversational abilities, starting the Generative AI boom.

description_zh: Meta 发布 LLaMA 模型，开启开源大语言模型的新时代。
description_en: Meta releases LLaMA models, opening a new era of open-source large language models.

description_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude，强调 AI 安全和有用性。
description_en: Anthropic releases Claude, emphasizing AI safety and helpfulness.

description_zh: Meta 发布 Llama 2，首个可商用的开源大语言模型。
description_en: Meta releases Llama 2, the first commercially usable open-source large language model.

description_zh: Mistral AI 发布 Mistral 7B，证明小模型也能达到强大性能。
description_en: Mistral AI releases Mistral 7B, proving small models can achieve powerful performance.

description_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 多模态大模型，原生支持文本、图像、音频和视频。
description_en: Google releases Gemini multimodal LLM, natively supporting text, image, audio, and video.

title_zh: Waymo 全无人驾驶商业许可
description_zh: Waymo 在旧金山获得全天候全无人驾驶商业运营许可。
description_en: Waymo receives 24/7 fully driverless commercial operation permit in San Francisco.

description_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-4，展现强大的多模态能力和推理能力，引发全球对AGI的讨论。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-4, demonstrating powerful multimodal and reasoning capabilities, sparking global discussion about AGI.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 Sora 视频生成模型，能够生成长达一分钟的高质量视频。
description_en: OpenAI releases Sora video generation model, capable of generating up to one minute of high-quality video.

description_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude 3 系列，Opus 版本在多项测试中超越 GPT-4。
description_en: Anthropic releases Claude 3 series, with Opus version surpassing GPT-4 on multiple tests.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o，实现毫秒级响应的多模态实时交互。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-4o, achieving millisecond-response multimodal real-time interaction.

description_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V2 模型，以极低成本实现高性能，引领开源模型新方向。
description_en: DeepSeek releases V2 model, achieving high performance at extremely low cost, leading new direction in open-source models.

description_zh: Apple 发布 Apple Intelligence，将 AI 能力深度整合到设备端。
description_en: Apple releases Apple Intelligence, deeply integrating AI capabilities on-device.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 o1 模型，展示强大的推理和问题解决能力。
description_en: OpenAI releases o1 model, demonstrating powerful reasoning and problem-solving capabilities.

description_zh: DeepSeek 发布 R1 推理模型，性能媲美 o1，并完全开源。
description_en: DeepSeek releases R1 reasoning model, matching o1 performance and fully open-sourced.

description_zh: Anthropic 持续更新 Claude 系列，在编程和推理能力上领先。
description_en: Anthropic continues updating Claude series, leading in coding and reasoning capabilities.

description_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4.5 和 o3 系列，持续推动大模型能力边界。
description_en: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5 and o3 series, continuously pushing LLM capability boundaries.
